entities.name: Hazel Kenrith
entities.description: A human child princess of Ardenvale on Eldraine, daughter of Algenus and Linden Kenrith, mischievous and brave.

entities.name: Algenus Kenrith
entities.description: High King of Eldraine and Hazel's father; mysteriously disappeared.

entities.name: Linden Kenrith
entities.description: Queen and Hazel's mother; subject of slanderous rumors.

entities.name: Will Kenrith
entities.description: Hazel's older half-brother she looks up to.

entities.name: Rowan Kenrith
entities.description: Hazel's older half-sibling who teases her.

entities.name: Ardenvale
entities.description: Realm of Eldraine ruled by the Kenriths.

events.summary: After Algenus's disappearance, Hazel spots a blue faerie infiltrator and kills it with her sling, alerting Will.
Hazel overhears rumors that Linden murdered Will and Rowan's mother; Will reassures her.
Hazel witnesses Rowan and Will decide to seek their missing father and is tasked with informing Linden.
events.quote: Hazel pledged her support and was tasked with informing Queen Linden of their departure.

relations.quote: The daughter of High King Algenus Kenrith
